commonPrompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Generate ONE 1536x1024 landscape portfolio implementation-summary illustration, using the provided PNG strictly as visual/character reference, NOT as the topic to copy. Preserve the warm off-white background (#fbfaf5), mint/amber panels, dark navy Korean sans-serif labels, crisp pixel-art objects and the brown-haired red-scarf adventurer, blue wizard and green ranger. These are illustrative actors in a technical concept picture, not screenshots. Create 3-4 generous visual panels with concrete input -> processing -> result arrows and before/after comparisons. Let pictures carry most of the explanation. Large readable labels, very few words, no dense paragraphs or source-code blocks, no tiny legends or ownership credits. Spell code identifiers exactly. No real addresses, secrets, GitHub logos, performance claims or invented implementation. All written Korean must follow the exact supplied labels. Show only CURRENT implemented behavior; a small explicitly limited note may describe a known boundary, never show a proposed improvement as implemented. Do not reuse the wood+iron recipes from the reference.
